requirements.item_text: A product quality review system exists.

mappings.quote: there is a system for product quality review

requirements.item_text: Management ensures the quality management system meets its intended objectives and measures how it is managed and how it performs in areas such as self-inspections, inspections, quality and supplier audits; complaints, returns and recalls; changes and deviations; rejected batches; quality control, OOS and OOT results; maintenance; qualification and validation; CAPA; and risk management.

mappings.quote: Management should ensure that the quality management system achieves its intended objectives and measures managing and performance in areas such as: ■ self-inspections, inspections, quality audits and supplier’s audits ■ complaints, returns and recalls ■ changes and deviations ■ rejected batches ■ quality control, out-of-specification results and out-of-trend results ■ maintenance ■ qualification and validation ■ corrective and preventive actions ■ risk management.

requirements.item_text: The manufacturer puts in place measures for continual improvement of the quality management system, of manufacturing and testing procedures, and of product quality.

mappings.quote: Manufacturers should implement measures to continuously improve the quality management system, manufacturing and testing procedures, and the quality of their products.

requirements.item_text: Improvement measures can include reviewing root causes of nonconformances, complaint investigations and their outcomes, and results of self-inspections, audits and other trends.

mappings.quote: These measures may include the review of root causes of nonconformances, quality complaint investigations and outcomes, and results from self-inspections, audits and other trends.

requirements.item_text: The quality unit makes sure critical deviations are investigated and resolved.

mappings.quote: Making sure that critical deviations are investigated and resolved.

requirements.item_text: The quality unit approves changes that could affect the quality of intermediates or APIs.

mappings.quote: Approving changes that potentially impact quality of intermediates or APIs.

requirements.item_text: The quality unit performs product quality reviews as defined in section 2.5.

mappings.quote: Performing product quality reviews (as deﬁned in section 2.5).

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures product realization through a system that is designed, qualified, planned, implemented, maintained and continually improved so products with appropriate quality attributes are delivered consistently.

mappings.quote: product realization is achieved by designing, qualifying, planning, implementing, maintaining and continuously improving a system that allows the consistent delivery of products with appropriate quality attributes

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures product and process knowledge is managed across all life-cycle stages.

mappings.quote: product and process knowledge is managed throughout all life- cycle stages

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures products are designed and developed taking account of GMP and related codes such as GLP and GCP.

mappings.quote: pharmaceutical products are designed and developed in a way that takes account of the requirements of GMP and other associated codes such as those of good laboratory practice (GLP) and good clinical practice (GCP)

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures production and control operations are clearly specified in writing and GMP requirements are adopted.

mappings.quote: production and control operations are clearly specified in a written form and GMP requirements are adopted

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures managerial responsibilities are clearly set out in job descriptions.

mappings.quote: managerial responsibilities are clearly specified in job descriptions

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures products and processes are monitored and the results are used in batch release, in deviation investigations, and to take preventive action against future deviations.

mappings.quote: product and processes are monitored and the results taken into account in batch release, in the investigation of deviations and, with a view to taking preventive action to avoid potential deviations occurring in the future

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures planned changes are evaluated and approved in advance, before implementation, taking regulatory notification and approval into account where required.

mappings.quote: arrangements are in place for the prospective evaluation and approval of planned changes and their approval prior to implementation taking into account regulatory notification and approval where required

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures that after any change is implemented, an evaluation confirms the quality objectives were met and product quality was not unintentionally harmed.

mappings.quote: After implementation of any change, an evaluation is undertaken to confirm that the quality objectives were achieved and that there was no unintended adverse impact on product quality

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures regular product quality reviews are carried out to verify process consistency and identify where improvement is needed.

mappings.quote: regular reviews of the quality of pharmaceutical products are conducted with the objective of verifying the consistency of the process and identifying where there is a need for improvement

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures a state of control is established and kept through effective monitoring and control systems for process performance and product quality.

mappings.quote: a state of control is established and maintained by developing and using effective monitoring and control systems for process performance and product quality

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures continual improvement is supported by implementing quality improvements suited to current process and product knowledge.

mappings.quote: continual improvement is facilitated through the implementation of quality improvements appropriate to the current level of process and product knowledge

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures a quality risk management system exists.

mappings.quote: there is a system for QRM

requirements.item_text: The PQS ensures deviations, suspected product defects and other problems are reported, investigated and recorded.

mappings.quote: deviations, suspected product defects and other problems are reported, investigated and recorded

requirements.item_text: A suitable level of root cause analysis is applied when investigating deviations, suspected defects and other problems.

mappings.quote: An appropriate level of root cause analysis is applied during such investigations.

requirements.item_text: Investigations identify the most likely root cause(s), and suitable corrective and/or preventive actions (CAPAs) are identified and carried out.

mappings.quote: The most likely root cause(s) should be identified and appropriate corrective actions and/or preventive actions (CAPAs) should be identified and taken.

requirements.item_text: The effectiveness of CAPAs is monitored.

mappings.quote: The effectiveness of CAPAs should be monitored.

requirements.item_text: Regular, periodic or rolling quality reviews are carried out for every product, export-only products included, to verify process consistency and that current starting material and finished product specifications are still appropriate, to show trends and to identify product and process improvements.

mappings.quote: Regular, periodic or rolling quality reviews of all pharmaceutical products, including export-only products, should be conducted with the objective of verifying the consistency of the existing process and the appropriateness of current specifications for both starting materials and finished product, to highlight any trends and to identify product and process improvements.

requirements.item_text: Product quality reviews are normally performed and documented annually, taking earlier reviews into account.

mappings.quote: Such reviews should normally be conducted and documented annually, taking into account previous reviews

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers starting and packaging materials used, especially those from new sources, and in particular the supply chain traceability of active substances.

mappings.quote: review of starting materials and packaging materials used for the product, especially those from new sources and in particular the review of supply chain traceability of active substances

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers critical in-process controls and finished product results.

mappings.quote: a review of critical in-process controls, and finished product results

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers every batch that failed its specification(s) and the related investigation.

mappings.quote: a review of all batches that failed to meet established specification(s) and their investigation

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers all significant deviations or non-conformances, their investigations, and how effective the resulting CAPAs were.

mappings.quote: a review of all significant deviations or non-conformances, the related investigations and the effectiveness of resultant CAPAs taken

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers all changes to processes or analytical methods.

mappings.quote: a review of all changes made to the processes or analytical methods

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers dossier variations submitted, granted or refused.

mappings.quote: a review of dossier variations submitted, granted or refused

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers stability monitoring programme results and any adverse trends.

mappings.quote: a review of the results of the stability monitoring programme and any adverse trends

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers all quality-related returns, complaints and recalls and the investigations done at the time.

mappings.quote: a review of all quality-related returns, complaints and recalls and the investigations performed at the time

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers whether any other earlier corrective actions on product processes or equipment were adequate.

mappings.quote: a review of adequacy of any other previous corrective actions on product processes or equipment

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers post-marketing commitments for new dossiers and dossier variations.

mappings.quote: post-marketing commitments for new dossiers and variations to the dossiers

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers the qualification status of relevant equipment and utilities (for example HVAC, water or compressed gases) and the results of monitoring their output.

mappings.quote: the qualification status of relevant equipment and utilities, e.g. heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC), water or compressed gases and a review of the results of monitoring the output of such equipment and utilities

requirements.item_text: The quality review covers technical agreements to confirm they are current.

mappings.quote: a review of technical agreements to ensure that they are up to date

requirements.item_text: The manufacturer, and the marketing authorization holder where different, evaluate the review results and assess, within the PQS, whether CAPA or revalidation is needed.

mappings.quote: The manufacturer and, where different, marketing authorization holder, should evaluate the results of the review and an assessment should be made as to whether CAPA or any revalidation should be undertaken, under the PQS.

requirements.item_text: CAPAs arising from the review are completed promptly and effectively following documented procedures.

mappings.quote: CAPAs should be completed in a timely and effective manner, according to documented procedures.

requirements.item_text: Procedures exist for the ongoing management and review of these CAPAs.

mappings.quote: There should be procedures for the ongoing management and review of these actions

requirements.item_text: Self-inspection verifies that the CAPA management and review procedures are effective.

mappings.quote: the effectiveness of these procedures should be verified during self-inspection

requirements.item_text: Where scientifically justified, quality reviews can be grouped by product type, for example solid, liquid or sterile dosage forms.

mappings.quote: Quality reviews may be grouped by product type, e.g. solid dosage forms, liquid dosage forms, or sterile products, where scientifically justified.

requirements.item_text: If the marketing authorization holder is not the manufacturer, a technical agreement between the parties sets out each party's responsibilities for producing the quality review.

mappings.quote: Where the marketing authorization holder is not the manufacturer, there should be a technical agreement in place between the various parties that defines their respective responsibilities in producing the quality review.

requirements.item_text: The authorized person responsible for final batch certification, jointly with the marketing authorization holder, ensures the quality review is done on time and is accurate.

mappings.quote: The authorized person responsible for final batch certification, together with the marketing authorization holder, should ensure that the quality review is performed in a timely manner and is accurate.
